760440101.text: There's a particularly tricky bounty at The Flagship with basically no leads.

760440102.text: The target was attacking people in the north of Lempo Isle, but now he's disappeared without a trace. No one seems to know where he's gone...

760440103.text: Every contact leaves a trace. No matter how carefully someone covers their tracks, in doing so, they always create new ones.

760440104.text: Besides, just because the bounty didn't include any extra information, doesn't mean whoever posted it doesn't have any.

760440105.text: I never thought of that... I'll go ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.

760440106.text: I'll leave it to you then.

760440107.text: You can count on me, Boss Nef!

760440201.text: Details on the targets are up on the board. I can fill you in if needed, but don't bother haggling over the bounties.

760440203.text: There are four targets on the board, but we only have leads for three. The first one's wanted for fraud...

760440204.text: ...Stop, stop, stop! Save me the spiel for the brand new treasure hunters — I could reel it off as well as you. You know who I'm here about.

760440205.text: The Curatorium wants to get involved?

760440206.text: That depends on how the Boss is feeling. Hmm, how did we arrive at you asking questions?

760440207.text: Anyway, seems to me the real reason Crackjaw's not been found is the lack of leads. Look at the board. You haven't even said what he looks like.

760440208.text: Well, if these treasure hunters set off without even knowing who they're looking for, well, they're hardly a match for someone like Hark. I don't want some novices wasting their time, much less throwing away their lives.

760440209.text: Fair point. Apart from the scar on his chin, what else can you tell me about him? Preferably something no one else knows?

760440210.text: Something no one else knows... You're looking for physical characteristics? Like, say, if he had some marks on his back?

760440211.text: That's exactly what I'm looking for! But how do you know so much about him?

760440212.text: I don't know squat. I never said he actually has any marks... Besides, even if he does, how are you going to see them?

760440213.text: W—Well, yeah, sorta... *sigh* So, there's nothing you can tell me? We've always worked well together — can't you give me anything to work with?

760440214.text: After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.

760440215.text: That's old news. Everyone and their dog knows that.

760440216.text: No one's reported seeing him recently. What if he went further north? I could maybe track him to Piramida, but what if he's made it all the way to Snezhnograd?

760440217.text: (Nothing but ice and snow up there. I'm not sure if my arm would function in the cold...)

760440218.text: He hasn't. He's still on Lempo Isle — I just don't know where. You can consider that "something no one else knows."

760440219.text: Huh, how can you be so certain?

760440220.text: Now that's a trade secret — you wanna know, you'll have to pay.

760440221.text: Hah, stingy! Still, a hulk of a man with a scar on his face... Even on Lempo Isle, they're not hard to find. How'm I supposed to know which one's Hark?

760440222.text: Well, seeing as how we "work together so well," I'll give you some free advice. Don't get too caught up in looking for a scar.

760440223.text: ...Are you saying, he's found some way to hide the scar on his chin?

760440224.text: I guess that makes sense. If everyone knows you as Crackjaw, walking around with no visible scar on your face would be a pretty good way to hide...

760440225.text: In that case, I just need to find someone who's deliberately hiding their jawline, right? It's a lead, at least... Alright, if I find anything new, I'll come back and fill you in.

760440301.text: Hmm... Seems like only yesterday, there were plenty of bounties going at The Flagship — now there's only one left.

760440302.text: #Apparently, that's all down to {NICKNAME}. But even {M#he}{F#she} hasn't been able to crack this last one.

760440303.text: Well, there really aren't any leads—

760440304.text: Ah, but... Just because something isn't written on the bounty board, doesn't mean it doesn't exist.

760440305.text: What's this — a sudden flash of inspiration?

760440306.text: I'm going to ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.

760440307.text: I'll leave it to you then.

760440308.text: You can count on me, Boss Nef!
